description.value: The study used structural MRI and voxel-based morphometry to compare gray matter density in heroin-dependent patients after 3 days and 1 month of abstinence with healthy controls, assessing whether abnormalities were reversible.

spans.text: Structural images were first spatially normalized to standard stereotaxic MNI space, and the spatially normalized images were then resliced to a final voxel size of 1 mm × 1 mm × 1 mm. After spatial normalization, images were segmented into gray matter, white matter, and cerebrospinal fluid. Modulated segments of gray matter were smoothed with a 6-mm FWHM isotropic Gaussian kernel.
